svg.text: Schematic, not to scale. AC bay left, DC bay right of the divider. Enclosure: OpenSCAD v12.0.
heatsink bond: ring terminal under a heatsink screw
J10 pins 2–4 and J7 pins 1, 4: insulate, leave unconnected
SSR: bare wire under the clamp plates, strands twisted, NOT tinned. T1/T2 at the SSR end toward the KP200, T3/T4 toward the divider.
Wagos are the junctions: the Shelly's manual says not to power other devices from its L terminals
and not to put several wires under one terminal. Shelly: strip 6–7 mm, 0.4 N·m. WAGO 221: strip 11 mm.
